entries.50.1: आश्रमे in the hermitage, सम्प्रवेशिताम् having been settled, मैथिलीम् Maithili, सीताम् Sita, दृष्ट्वा तु having seen, दीनचेतनः dejected in mind, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, घोरम् terrible, सन्तापम् anguish, अगमत् came to
entries.50.2: महातेजाः of great splendour, मन्त्रसारथिम् charioteer and counsellor, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, अब्रवीच्च and said, सारथे O charioteer, रामस्य of Rama, सीतासन्तापजम् born of grief for Sita, दुःखम् the sorrow, पश्य behold
entries.50.3: ततः than that, दुःखतरम् more grievous, किं नु what indeed, राघवस्य for Raghava, भविष्यति shall there be, शुद्धसमाचाराम् of pure conduct, जनकात्मजाम् daughter of Janaka, पत्नीम् his wife, विसृज्य having cast off
entries.50.4: सारथे O charioteer, अहम् I, व्यक्तम् clearly, दैवात् by fate, राघवस्य for Raghava, वैदेह्या from Vaidehi, विना apart, नित्यम् for ever, भवम् this state, मन्ये deem, दैवं हि fate indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् is hard to overpass
entries.50.5: यः who, क्रुद्धः when enraged, सगन्धर्वान् with the gandharvas, देवान् the gods, राक्षसैः सह along with the rakshasas, असुरान् the asuras, निहन्यात् could destroy, सः that, राघवः Raghava, दैवम् fate, अनुवर्तते follows
entries.50.6: पुरा formerly, रामः Rama, पितुः of his father, वाक्यात् at the word, विजने in the lonely, दण्डके Dandaka, वने forest, महावने in the great wood, नव nine, वर्षाणि years, पञ्च चैव and five, उषित्वा having dwelt
entries.50.7: ततः than that, भूयः yet more, दुःखतरम् grievous, पौराणाम् of the citizens, वचनम् the talk, श्रुत्वा having heard, सीतायाः of Sita, विप्रवासनम् the banishment, मे to me, नृशंसम् cruel, प्रतिभाति appears
entries.50.8: सूत O charioteer, हीनार्थवादिभिः who speak of base matters, पौरैः by the citizens, मैथिलीं प्रति concerning Maithili, सम्प्राप्तः brought about, यशोहरे fame-destroying, अस्मिन् in this, कर्मणि deed, कः नु what indeed, धर्माश्रयः is the ground in dharma
entries.50.9: लक्ष्मणभाषिताः spoken by Lakshmana, एताः these, बहुविधाः of many kinds, वाचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्राज्ञः the wise, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, श्रद्धया with earnestness, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.50.10: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, त्वया by you, मैथिलीं प्रति concerning Maithili, सन्तापः grief, न कार्यः should not be made, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, एतत् this, पुरा long ago, ते your, पितुः father, अग्रतः before, विप्रैः by the brahmins, दृष्टम् was foreseen
entries.50.11: रामः Rama, दुःखप्रायः अपि though beset with sorrow, दृढम् assuredly, सौख्यभाक् a partaker of happiness, भविष्यति shall be, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, प्रियैः from those dear to him, विप्रयोगम् separation, ध्रुवम् certainly, प्राप्स्यते च and shall meet with
entries.50.12: महान् the great one, धर्मात्मा the righteous, महता after a long, कालेन time, त्वां चैव you, मैथिलीं चैव and Maithili, उभौ both, शत्रुघ्नभरतौ Shatrughna and Bharata, सन्त्यजिष्यति shall forsake
entries.50.13: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, इदम् this, त्वयि by you, भरते अपि वा or to Bharata either, न वक्तव्यम् must not be told, दुर्वासाः Durvasas, यत् what, उवाच ह spoke, राज्ञा by the king, वः to you, व्याहृतम् uttered, वाक्यम् the word
entries.50.14: नरर्षभ O bull among men, महाजनसमीपे before a great gathering, मम चैव and before me too, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, सन्निधौ च and in the presence, ऋषिणा by the sage, वाक्यम् the word, व्याहृतम् was uttered
entries.50.15: ऋषेः तु and of the sage, वचनम् the word, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुरुषर्षभः the bull among men, माम् to me, आह said, सूत O charioteer, एवम् in this way, ते by you, जनसन्निधौ before people, क्वचित् anywhere, न वक्तव्यम् must not be told
entries.50.16: सौम्य O gentle one, अहम् I, सुसमाहितः well composed, तस्य of that, लोकपालस्य guardian of the world, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, जातु ever, अनृतम् false, न एव कार्यम् must never be made, इति thus, मे my, दर्शनम् is the view
entries.50.17: सौम्य O gentle one, मया by me, तवाग्रतः before you, सर्वथा एव in any case whatever, न वक्तव्यम् it should not be told, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, ते your, श्रवणे in the hearing, श्रद्धा eagerness, यदि if there is, श्रूयताम् let it be heard
entries.50.18: अहम् I, यदि अपि although, पुरा formerly, नरेन्द्रेण by the lord of men, रहस्यम् the secret, श्रावितः was made to hear, तथा अपि even so, उदाहरिष्यामि I shall declare it, दैवं हि fate indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् is hard to overpass
entries.50.19: येन whereby, इदम् this, ईदृशम् such, शोकसमन्वितम् attended with grief, दुःखम् sorrow, प्राप्तम् has come, त्वया by you, भरते to Bharata, शत्रुघ्नस्य अपि of Shatrughna too, सन्निधौ in the presence, न वाच्यम् it is not to be spoken
entries.50.20: तत् that, गम्भीरार्थपदम् of deep meaning in its words, महत् weighty, तस्य his, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, अथ then, सूतम् to the charioteer, तथ्यम् the truth, ब्रूहि इति pray tell, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.51.1: महात्मना by the great-souled, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, तथा thus, सञ्चोदितः urged, सूतः the charioteer, ऋषिणा by the sage, प्रोक्तम् spoken, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, व्याहर्तुम् to relate, उपचक्रमे set about
entries.51.2: पुरा long ago, दुर्वासा नाम Durvasas by name, महामुनिः the great sage, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रः हि the son indeed, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, पुण्ये holy, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वार्षिक्यम् the rainy season, समुवास ह took up his abode for
entries.51.3: महातेजाः of great splendour, सुमहायशाः of exceedingly great renown, ते your, पिता father, महात्मानम् the great-souled, पुरोहितम् family priest, दिदृक्षुः wishing to see, अयम् he, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, अगमत् went to
entries.51.4: सः he, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, सव्यपार्श्वे at the left side, उपविष्टम् seated, सूर्यसङ्काशम् resembling the sun, तेजसा with splendour, ज्वलन्तम् इव as though blazing, महामुनिम् the great sage, दृष्ट्वा having seen
entries.51.4.1: विनीतः humbly, तापसश्रेष्ठौ best of ascetics, तौ those two, मुनी sages, अभिवादयत् हि did indeed salute, सः he, राजा the king, ताभ्याम् by those two, स्वागतेन with a welcome, आसनेन च and with a seat, पूजितः was honoured
entries.51.5: विनीतः humbly, तापसश्रेष्ठौ best of ascetics, तौ those two, मुनी sages, अभिवादयत् हि did indeed salute, सः he, राजा the king, ताभ्याम् by those two, स्वागतेन with a welcome, आसनेन च and with a seat, पूजितः was honoured
entries.51.6: पाद्येन with water for the feet, फलमूलैश्च and with fruits and roots, मुनिभिः सह along with the sages, उवास he dwelt
entries.51.7: तत्र there, उपविष्टानाम् seated together, तेषाम् of those, परमर्षीणाम् supreme sages, अहनि when the day, मध्यादित्यगते had brought the sun to mid-heaven, ताः ताः many and various, सुमधुराः most sweet, कथाः tales, बभूवुः arose
entries.51.8: ततः then, कस्याञ्चित् in the course of a certain, कथायाम् tale, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, प्रग्रहः in an attitude of submission, नृपः the king, तम् that, महात्मानम् great-souled one, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रम् son, तपोधनम् rich in austerity, उवाच addressed
entries.51.9: भगवन् O venerable one, मम my, वंशः line, किम् what, प्रमाणेन in measure, भविष्यति shall be, मे my, रामः Rama, किमायुश्च हि and of what span of life, अन्ये the others, पुत्राश्च and my sons, किमायुषः of what span
entries.51.10: भगवन् O venerable one, रामस्य of Rama, ये सुताः what sons, स्युः there may be, तेषाम् their, आयुः lifetime, कियत् how much, भवेत् may be, मम my, अस्य this, वंशस्य of the line, गतिम् the course, काम्यया of your grace, ब्रूहि tell
entries.51.11: राज्ञः of king, दशरथस्य च Dasharatha, तत् that, व्याहृतम् uttered, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, सुमहातेजाः of exceedingly great splendour, दुर्वासाः Durvasas, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्रमे began
entries.51.12: राजन् O king, पुरावृत्तम् what befell of old, शृणु hear, तदा then, देवासुरे between gods and asuras, युधि in the war, सुरैः by the gods, भर्त्स्यमानाः being harried, दैत्याः the daityas, भृगुपत्नीम् the wife of Bhrigu, समाश्रिताः took refuge with
entries.51.13: तया by her, परिगृहीतान् taken under protection, तान् them, दृष्ट्वा having seen, क्रुद्धः enraged, सुरेश्वरः the lord of the gods, शितधारेण of keen edge, चक्रेण with his discus, भृगुपत्न्याः of the wife of Bhrigu, शिरः the head, अहरत् struck off
entries.51.14: ततः then, ताम् that, पत्नीम् wife, निहताम् slain, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भृगुकुलोद्वहः the upholder of the line of Bhrigu, क्रुद्धः enraged, सहसा at once, रिपुकुलार्दनम् crusher of the ranks of foes, विष्णुम् Vishnu, शशाप cursed
entries.51.15: जनार्दन O Janardana, यस्मात् since, क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with wrath, मे my, अवध्याम् inviolable, पत्नीम् wife, अवधीः you slew, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, मानुषे in the human, लोके world, जनिष्यसि shall take birth
entries.51.16: तत्र there, त्वम् you, बहुवार्षिकम् lasting many years, पत्नीवियोगम् separation from your wife, प्राप्स्यसे shall meet with
entries.51.17: सः he, शापाभिहतचेताः his mind stricken by the curse, स्वात्मना in his own self, भावितः absorbed, अभवत् became
entries.51.18: शापेन by the curse, पीडितः afflicted, भृगुः Bhrigu, तम् that, देवम् god, अर्चयामास worshipped, तपसा by austerity, आराधितः propitiated, भक्तवत्सलः fond of his devotees, देवः the god, अब्रवीत् हि did indeed speak, लोकानाम् of the worlds, संहितार्थं तु for the welfare, तम् that, शापम् curse, ग्राह्यम् as one to be accepted, उक्तवान् he declared
entries.51.19: इति thus, पूर्वजन्मनि in a former birth, भृगुणा by Bhrigu, शप्तः cursed, महातेजाः of great splendour, पार्थिवसत्तम O best of kings, इह here, तव your, पुत्रत्वम् sonship, आगतः हि has indeed come to
entries.51.20: मानद O bestower of honour, त्रिषु in the three, लोकेषु worlds, राम इति as Rama, अभिविख्यातः is renowned, भृगुशापकृतम् wrought by the curse of Bhrigu, महत् great, तत् that, फलम् fruit, प्राप्स्यते चापि and he shall also meet with
entries.51.21: रामः Rama, दीर्घकालम् for a long time, अयोध्यायाः of Ayodhya, पती lord, भविष्यति shall be, अस्य his, ये अनुगाः those who follow him, सुखिनश्च happy, समृद्धाश्च and prosperous, भविष्यन्ति shall be
entries.51.22: रामः Rama, दश ten, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, वर्षशतानि च and hundreds of years, राज्यम् the kingdom, उपासित्वा having governed, ब्रह्मलोकम् to the world of Brahma, गमिष्यति shall go
entries.51.23: परमदुर्जयः exceedingly hard to conquer, समृद्धैः with abundant, अश्वमेधैश्च horse-sacrifices, इष्ट्वा having sacrificed, बहुशः many times over, बहून् many, राजवंशान् च royal lines, संस्थापयिष्यति shall establish
entries.51.24: राघवस्य तु of Raghava, सीतायाम् by Sita, द्वौ two, पुत्रौ तु sons indeed, भविष्येते shall be born, अन्यत्र elsewhere, न त्वयोध्यायाम् and not in Ayodhya, एतत् this, सत्यम् is true, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.51.25: ततः then, राघवः Raghava, सीतायाः of Sita, पुत्रौ the two sons, अभिषेक्ष्यति shall consecrate
entries.51.26: सुमहातेजाः of exceedingly great splendour, महामुनिः the great sage, सः he, राज्ञः of the king, वंशस्य of the line, अखिलम् entire, सर्वम् all, गतागतम् the coming and the going, आह told, आख्याय having related it, तूष्णीम् silent, आसीत् remained
entries.51.27: तदा then, तस्मिन् when that, मुनौ sage, तूष्णीम्भूते had fallen silent, राजा king, दशरथः Dasharatha, महात्मानौ the two great-souled ones, अभिवाद्य having saluted, पुनः again, पुरोत्तमम् to the best of cities, आयात् returned
entries.51.28: एतत् this, वचः word, मया by me, तत्र there, पुरा of old, मुनिना by the sage, व्याहृतम् uttered, श्रुतम् was heard, हृदि in the heart, निक्षिप्तं च and laid up, तत् that, अन्यथा otherwise, न भविष्यति shall not come to pass
entries.51.29: राघव O Raghava, एवम् thus, गते things being so, सन्तापम् grief, कर्तुम् to make, न अर्हसि you ought not, नरोत्तम O best of men, सीतार्थे for Sita's sake, राघवार्थे वा or for Raghava's sake, दृढः firm, भव be
entries.51.30: सूतस्य of the charioteer, परमाद्भुतम् most wonderful, व्याहृतम् uttered, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, अतुलम् unmatched, प्रहर्षम् delight, लेभे he obtained, साधु साधु इति च and well and well, अब्रवीत् said
entries.51.31: ततः then, पथि on the road, एवम् thus, संवदतोः as they conversed, सूतलक्ष्मणयोः the charioteer and Lakshmana, अर्के when the sun, अस्तम् to its setting, गते had gone, तौ those two, अथ then, केशिन्याम् at Keshini, वासम् lodging, ऊषतुः took
entries.52.1: रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तत्र there, केशिन्याम् at Keshini, ताम् that, रजनीम् night, उष्य having passed, प्रभाते at dawn, पुनः again, उत्थाय having risen, तदा then, प्रययौ set forth
entries.52.2: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे when half the day, प्राप्ते was reached, महारथः the great chariot-warrior, रत्नसम्पूर्णाम् filled with jewels, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम् thronged with happy and thriving people, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविवेश entered
entries.52.3: सुमहामतिः of exceedingly great mind, सौमित्रिः तु and Saumitri, परम् utmost, दैन्यम् dejection, जगाम came to, रामपादौ the feet of Rama, समासाद्य having reached, गतः having come there, अहम् I, किम् what, वक्ष्यामि shall I say
entries.52.4: एवम् thus, चिन्तयानस्य of him as he pondered, तस्य his, शशिसन्निभम् resembling the moon, परमोदारम् most noble, रामस्य of Rama, भवनम् the palace, पुरस्तात् in front, समदृश्यत came into view
entries.52.5: सः he, राज्ञः तु and of the king, भवनद्वारि at the palace gate, रथोत्तमात् from the best of chariots, अवतीर्य having descended, अवाङ्मुखः his face bent down, दीनमनाः dejected in mind, अनिवारितः unhindered, प्रविवेश entered
entries.52.6: सः he, परमासने upon the high seat, आसीनम् seated, दीनम् sorrowful, राघवम् Raghava, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अश्रुपूर्णाभ्याम् filled with tears, नेत्राभ्याम् with both eyes, अग्रतः before him, अग्रजम् his elder brother, ददर्श beheld
entries.52.7: दीनचेतनः dejected in mind, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तस्य his, चरणौ feet, जग्राह clasped, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, सुसमाहितः well composed, दीनया in a piteous, वाचा voice, उवाच spoke
entries.52.8: आर्यस्य of my noble brother, आज्ञाम् the command, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, जनकात्मजाम् the daughter of Janaka, गङ्गातीरे on the bank of the Ganga, यथोद्दिष्टे as was directed, शुचौ in the pure, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, आश्रमे hermitage, विसृज्य having left
entries.52.9: वीर O hero, तत्र there, आश्रमान्ते at the edge of the hermitage, शुभाचाराम् of virtuous conduct, यशस्विनीम् the illustrious lady, ताम् च her, पादमूलम् the soles of your feet, उपासितुम् to wait upon, पुनः अपि once again, आगतः I have come
entries.52.10: पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, मा शुचः grieve not, कालस्य of time, गतिः the course, ईदृशी is such, त्वद्विधाः those like you, बुद्धिमन्तः the wise, मनस्विनः the high-minded, न हि शोचन्ति do not grieve at all
entries.52.11: सर्वे all, निचयाः accumulations, क्षयान्ताः end in decay, समुच्छ्रयाः exaltations, पतनान्ताः end in a fall, संयोगाः unions, विप्रयोगान्ताः end in separation, जीवितं च and life, मरणान्तम् ends in death
entries.52.12: तस्मात् therefore, पुत्रेषु in sons, दारेषु in wives, मित्रेषु in friends, धनेषु च and in wealth, अतिप्रसङ्गः excessive attachment, न कर्तव्यः is not to be made, तैः from them, विप्रयोगः हि separation indeed, ध्रुवम् is certain
entries.52.13: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, त्वम् you, मनसा एव हि by the mind alone indeed, आत्मना by yourself, आत्मानम् yourself, सर्वान् all, लोकांश्च and the worlds, विनेतुम् to govern, शक्तः are able, आत्मनः your own, शोकम् grief, किं पुनः how much more
entries.52.14: त्वद्विधाः those like you, पुरुषर्षभाः bulls among men, ईदृशेषु in such matters, न विमुह्यन्ति are not bewildered, राघव O Raghava, सः that, अपवादः slander, ते for you, पुनः again, एष्यति किल will surely return
entries.52.15: नृप O king, यदर्थम् for the sake of which, अपवादभयात् from fear of slander, मैथिली Maithili, त्यक्ता was abandoned, राजन् O king, सः that, अपवादः slander, पुरे in the city, भविष्यति will arise, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.52.16: पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, सः त्वम् you being such, धैर्येण with fortitude, सुसमाहितः well composed, एनाम् this, दुर्बलाम् feeble, बुद्धिम् thought, त्यज cast off, सन्तापम् grief, मा कुरुष्व ह make not
entries.52.17: महात्मना by the great-souled, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सः that, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, मित्रवत्सलः fond of his friends, परया with the utmost, प्रीत्या affection, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, उवाच said
entries.52.18: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, यथा as, वदसि you say, एतत् this, एवम् is so, वीर O hero, मम my, कार्यानुशासने in the carrying out of my charge, मे my, परितोषश्च and satisfaction
entries.52.19: सौम्य O gentle one, निवृत्तिश्च and calm, आगता has come, सन्तापश्च and the anguish, निराकृतः has been driven off, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, सुरुचिरैः most pleasing, भवद्वाक्यैः by your words, अनुनीतः अस्मि I have been consoled
entries.53.1: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, तत् that, परमाद्भुतम् most wonderful, वाक्यम् speech, निशम्य having heard, रामः Rama, सुप्रीतः च and well pleased, अभवत् became, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.53.2: सौम्य O gentle one, महाबुद्धेः of great understanding, मम my, यादृशः such as, मनोऽनुगः following my mind, त्वम् you are, ईदृशः तु such indeed, बन्धुः a kinsman, अस्मिन् in this, काले time, विशेषतः especially, दुर्लभः is hard to find
entries.53.3: शुभलक्षण O you of auspicious marks, यत् च and what, मे my, हृदये in the heart, किञ्चित् somewhat, वर्तते stirs, तत् that, निशामय hear, श्रुत्वा च and having heard, मम my, वचनम् word, कुरुष्व carry out
entries.53.4: सौम्य O gentle one, सौमित्रे O Saumitri, चत्वारः four, दिवसाः days, पौरजनस्य of the citizenry, कार्यम् वै the business indeed, अकुर्वाणस्य of me who has not attended to, तत् that, मे my, मर्माणि vital parts, कृन्तति cuts through
entries.53.5: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, प्रकृतयः the ministers of state, पुरोधाः the family priest, तथा likewise, मन्त्रिणः the counsellors, कार्यार्थिनः those seeking redress, पुरुषाः the men, स्त्रियश्च and the women, आहूयन्ताम् let them be summoned
entries.53.6: यः राजा whatever king, दिने दिने day by day, पौरकार्याणि the affairs of the citizens, न करोति does not attend to, संवृते in a covered, घोरे dreadful, नरके hell, पतितः has fallen, अत्र herein, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.53.7: पुरा of old, नृगो नाम Nriga by name, महायशाः of great renown, राजा a king, ब्रह्मण्यः devoted to brahmins, सत्यवाक् truthful in speech, शुचिः pure, पृथिवीपालः a protector of the earth, बभूव there was, श्रूयते हि so it is indeed heard
entries.53.8: सः he, नृदेवः the god among men, नृपः the king, कदाचित् once, सवत्साः with their calves, स्वर्णभूषिताः adorned with gold, गवाम् of cows, कोटीः crores, पुष्करेषु at Pushkara, भूमिदेवेभ्यः to the gods on earth, ददौ gave
entries.53.9: अनघ O sinless one, ततः then, सङ्गात् from the herd, सवत्सा with her calf, गता having strayed, धेनुः a cow, अहिताग्नेः who maintained the sacred fire, दरिद्रस्य poor, उञ्छवर्तिनः living by gleaning, ब्राह्मणस्य to a brahmin, स्पर्शिता was given away
entries.53.10: क्षुधार्तः तु and afflicted with hunger, सः he, नष्टाम् the lost, गाम् cow, तत्र तत्र च here and there, अन्विषन् searching, बहून् many, संवत्सरगणान् troops of years, सर्वराज्येषु in all the kingdoms, वै indeed, न अपश्यत् did not find her
entries.53.11: ततः then, कनखलम् to Kanakhala, गत्वा having gone, ब्राह्मणस्य of a brahmin, निवेशने in the dwelling, जीर्णवत्साम् her calf grown old, निरामयाम् free of ailment, स्वकाम् his own, गाम् cow, धेनुम् the milch cow, ददर्श he saw
entries.53.12: अथ then, सः that, द्विजः brahmin, ताम् her, स्वकेन by her own, नामधेयेन name, उवाच called, शबले O Shabala, आगच्छ come, इति एवम् thus, सा तु and she, गौः the cow, स्वरम् the voice, शुश्राव heard
entries.53.13: क्षुधार्तस्य of him afflicted with hunger, तस्य his, द्विजस्य वै of that brahmin, तम् that, स्वरम् voice, आज्ञाय having known, सा that, गौः cow, पावकोपमम् resembling fire, गच्छन्तम् as he went, पृष्ठतः behind, अन्वगात् followed
entries.53.14: यः अपि and he who, पालयते was keeping her, विप्रः the brahmin, सः अपि he too, द्रुतम् swiftly, गाम् the cow, अन्वगात् followed, गत्वा having gone, सत्वरम् at once, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, मम my, गौः is the cow, इति thus, आचष्ट declared
entries.53.15: राजसिंहेन by the lion among kings, नृगेण ह by Nriga indeed, स्पर्शिता given away, मम to me, दत्ता was granted, ततः then, विपश्चितोः learned, तयोः of those two, ब्राह्मणयोः brahmins, महान् a great, वादः dispute, आसीत् arose
entries.53.16: ततः then, अन्योन्यम् with each other, विवदन्तौ disputing, दातारम् the giver, अभिजग्मतुः approached, तौ those two, राजभवनद्वारि at the gate of the royal palace, नृगशासनम् admittance to Nriga, न प्राप्तौ obtained not
entries.53.17: अनेकानि many, अहोरात्राणि days and nights, वसन्तौ waiting, क्रोधम् to wrath, ईयतुः gave way, महात्मानौ great-souled, द्विजसत्तमौ best of the twice-born, तौ those, उभौ both, क्रुद्धौ enraged, परमसम्प्राप्तौ driven to the extreme, घोराभिसंहितम् fraught with dreadful purpose, वाक्यम् a word, ऊचतुः च and uttered
entries.53.18: यस्मात् since, अर्थिनाम् of suitors, कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थम् for the accomplishing of their business, त्वम् you, दर्शनम् audience, न एषि do not grant, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, अदृश्यः invisible, कृकलासः a lizard, भविष्यसि you shall become
entries.53.19: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि many thousands of years, बहुवर्षशतानि च and many hundreds of years, अस्मिन् in this, श्वभ्रे pit, कृकलासः वै as a lizard indeed, दीर्घकालम् for a long time, वसिष्यसि you shall dwell
entries.53.20: अस्मिन् in this, लोके world, यदूनाम् of the Yadus, कीर्तिवर्धनः increaser of the fame, वासुदेव इति as Vasudeva, ख्यातः renowned, पुरुषविग्रहः in human form, विष्णुः Vishnu, उत्पत्स्यते हि shall indeed be born
entries.53.21: राजन् O king, सः he, तस्मात् from that, शापात् curse, ते your, मोक्षयिता deliverer, भविष्यसि you shall be, तेन by him, कालेन in that time, कृता wrought, ते your, निष्कृतिः release, भविष्यति shall come
entries.53.22: भारावतरणार्थं हि for the lightening of the earth's burden, महावीर्यौ of great valour, नरनारायणौ Nara and Narayana, उभौ both, कलौ युगे in the Kali age, उपस्थिते when it is at hand, उत्पत्स्येते shall be born
entries.53.23: एवम् thus, तौ those two, ब्राह्मणौ brahmins, शापम् the curse, उत्सृज्य having let fall, विगतज्वरौ their heat gone, दुर्बलाम् feeble, वृद्धाम् aged, ताम् that, गां हि cow indeed, ब्राह्मणाय वै to the brahmin, ददतुः gave
entries.53.24: एवम् thus, सः that, राजा king, तम् that, सुदारुणम् most terrible, शापम् curse, उपभुङ्क्ते undergoes
entries.53.25: कार्यार्थिनाम् of those seeking redress, विमर्दः हि the thwarting indeed, राज्ञाम् for kings, दोषाय to blame, कल्पते conduces, तत् therefore, कार्यिणः those with business, शीघ्रम् swiftly, मह्यम् to me, दर्शनम् audience, अभिवर्तन्तु let them come to
entries.53.26: सुकृतस्य of a well-done, कार्यस्य task, फलम् the fruit, पार्थिवः the king, न अपैति loses not, तस्मात् therefore, सौमित्रे O Saumitri, गच्छ go, कार्यवान् having business, जनः the people, प्रतीक्षस्व await
entries.54.1: परमार्थवित् knower of the highest truth, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendour, राघवम् to Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.54.2: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, अल्पापराधे for so slight an offence, द्विजाभ्याम् by the two brahmins, ईदृशः such, महान् a great, शापः curse, नृगस्य upon Nriga, राजर्षेः the royal sage, अपरः another, यमदण्डः इव like the rod of Yama
entries.54.3: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, आत्मानम् himself, पापसंयुक्तम् bound to sin, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, नृगः Nriga, राजा the king, क्रोधसमन्वितौ filled with wrath, द्विजौ to the two brahmins, किम् what, उवाच did he say
entries.54.4: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, राघवः Raghava, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् spoke, सौम्य O gentle one, यथा how, पूर्वम् formerly, सः that, राजा king, शापविक्षतः wounded by the curse, शृणु hear
entries.54.5: अथ then, तदा then, सः that, नृगः Nriga, विप्रौ the two brahmins, अध्वनि on their road, गतौ had gone, विज्ञाय having learnt, सर्वान् all, मन्त्रिणः the counsellors, नैगमान् the townsmen, सपुरोधसः along with the family priest, आहूय having summoned
entries.54.6: नृगः Nriga, राजा the king, दुःखेन with sorrow, सुसमाविष्टः wholly possessed, तान् them, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतीः तथा and likewise the subjects, उवाच addressed, समाहितैः with attentive minds, मे my words, श्रूयताम् let them be heard
entries.54.7: नारदः Narada, पर्वतश्चैव and Parvata, मम to me, महत् great, भयम् terror, दत्त्वा having given, भद्रौ the blessed pair, अनिन्दितौ the blameless, वायुभूतौ become as the wind, त्रिभुवनम् to the three worlds, गतौ have gone
entries.54.8: वसुर्नाम Vasu by name, अयम् this, कुमारः prince, सः that, देवः lord, अद्य today, अभिषिच्यताम् let him be consecrated, मम for me, शिल्पिभिः by the artisans, सुखस्पर्शम् pleasant to the touch, यत् which, श्वभ्रम् a pit, क्रियताम् let it be made, यत्र where, अहम् I, ब्राह्मणनिःसृतम् issued from the brahmins, शापम् the curse, सङ्क्षयिष्यामि shall wear out
entries.54.9: शिल्पिनः the artisans, वर्षघ्नम् one that keeps off the rain, एकम् one, श्वभ्रं तु pit, तथा likewise, अपरम् another, हिमघ्नम् that keeps off the frost, एकम् one, ग्रीष्मघ्नं तु and one that keeps off the summer heat, सुखस्पर्शम् pleasant to the touch, कुर्वन्तु let them make
entries.54.10: ये वृक्षाः what trees, फलवन्तः are fruit-bearing, याः लताः what creepers, पुष्पवत्यश्च and are flowering, बहुविधाः of many kinds, छायावन्तः shade-giving, गुल्मिनश्च and bushy, विरोप्यन्ताम् let them be planted
entries.54.11: श्वभ्राणाम् of the pits, सर्वतोदिशम् on every side, रमणीयम् a delightful place, क्रियताम् च and let it be made, अत्र here, कालस्य of the time, पर्ययः the turning, यावत् until, सुखम् in comfort, वसिष्यामि I shall dwell
entries.54.12: तेषु in them, सुगन्धीनि fragrant, पुष्पाणि च and flowers, नित्यशः constantly, क्रियताम् let there be, यथा so that, मे for me, अध्यर्धम् a yojana and a half, योजनम् in extent, परिवार्य surrounding, तथा so, स्युः may they be
entries.54.13: एवम् thus, विधानम् the arrangement, कृत्वा having made, सः he, तदा then, वसम् Vasu, सन्दिदेश instructed, पुत्र O son, धर्मनित्यः ever devoted to dharma, क्षत्रधर्मेण by the law of the kshatriya, प्रजाः the people, पालय protect
entries.54.14: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, यथा how, सरोषाभ्याम् by the two enraged ones, द्विजाभ्याम् by the brahmins, तादृशे so slight, अपराधे अपि though the offence, मयि upon me, शापः the curse, पातितः was let fall, ते to you, प्रत्यक्षम् is manifest
entries.54.15: नरर्षभ O bull among men, मत्कृते अपि even on my account, तनुसन्तापम् torment of the body, मा कृथाः make not, पुत्र O son, कृतान्तः the ordainer of ends, कुशलः is skilful, येन by whom, अस्मि I have been, व्यसनीकृतः plunged in calamity
entries.54.16: प्राप्तव्यानि एव what must be attained, प्राप्नोति one attains, गन्तव्यानि एव where one must go, गच्छति one goes, लब्धव्यानि एव what must be got, दुःखानि च sorrows, सुखानि च and joys, लभते one gets
entries.54.17: वत्स O child, पूर्वे in a former, जात्यन्तरे other birth, विषादम् despair, मा कुरुष्व ह give not way to
entries.54.18: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, एवम् thus, सुतम् to his son, उक्त्वा having spoken, महायशाः of great renown, नृपः the ruler, राजा the king, तत्र there, वासाय for his dwelling, सुकृतम् the well-made, श्वभ्रम् pit, जगाम went to
entries.54.19: एवम् thus, महात्मा the great-souled one, नृपः the king, तदानीम् then, महारत्नविभूषितम् adorned with great gems, तत् that, श्वभ्रम् pit, प्रविश्य एव having entered, तदा then, द्विजाभ्याम् by the two brahmins, रुषा हि in wrath indeed, विमुक्तम् loosed, शापम् the curse, सम्पादयामास carried through to its end
entries.55.1: ते to you, नृगशापस्य of the curse of Nriga, एषः this, विस्तरः full account, मया by me, अभिहितः has been told, श्रवणे in the hearing, श्रद्धा eagerness, यदि if, अस्ति there is, इह here, अपराम् another, कथाम् tale, शृणुष्व hear
entries.55.2: रामेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, नृप O king, आश्चर्यभूतानाम् that are marvels, कथानाम् of tales, मे for me, तृप्तिः satiety, नास्ति there is none
entries.55.3: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः the delight of the Ikshvakus, रामः Rama, परमधर्मिष्ठाम् most righteous, कथाम् a tale, व्याहर्तुम् to relate, उपचक्रमे set about
entries.55.4: महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् Ikshvakus, निमिर्नाम Nimi by name, राजा a king, आसीत् there was, द्वादशमः the twelfth, पुत्रः son, वीर्ये in valour, धर्मे च and in dharma, परिनिष्ठितः perfectly established
entries.55.5: वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valour, सः that, राजा king, तदा then, गौतमस्य of Gautama, अभ्याशे तु in the neighbourhood, देवपुरोपमम् resembling the city of the gods, पुरम् a city, निवेशयामास founded
entries.55.6: पुरस्य of the city, सुकृतम् well built, वैजयन्तम् इति as Vaijayanta, नाम the name, श्रुतम् is known, यत्र where, महायशाः of great renown, राजर्षिः the royal sage, निमिः Nimi, निवेशम् the settlement, चक्रे made
entries.55.7: सुमहापुरम् the very great city, निवेश्य having founded, तस्य his, बुद्धिः the thought, समुत्पन्ना arose, पितुः of my father, मनः the mind, प्रह्लादयन् gladdening, दीर्घसत्रेण with a long sacrificial session, यजेयम् may I sacrifice
entries.55.8: ततः then, मनोः of Manu, सुतम् the son, इक्ष्वाकुं हि Ikshvaku indeed, पितरम् his father, आमन्त्र्य having taken leave of, पूर्वम् first, ब्रह्मर्षिसत्तमम् best of brahmin sages, वसिष्ठम् Vasishtha, वरयामास he chose
entries.55.9: अनन्तरम् next, सः that, राजर्षिः royal sage, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of the Ikshvakus, निमिः Nimi, अत्रिम् Atri, अङ्गिरसं चैव and Angiras, तपोधनम् rich in austerity, भृगुं चैव and Bhrigu
entries.55.10: वसिष्ठः तु and Vasishtha, राजर्षिसत्तमम् best of royal sages, तम् that, निमिम् Nimi, उवाच told, अहम् I, पूर्वम् already, इन्द्रेण by Indra, वृतः have been chosen, अन्तरम् the interval, प्रतिपालय await
entries.55.11: अनन्तरम् thereupon, महाविप्रः the great brahmin, गौतमः Gautama, प्रत्यपूरयत् filled the office, महातेजाः of great splendour, वसिष्ठः अपि Vasishtha too, अथ then, इन्द्रयज्ञम् the sacrifice of Indra, अकरोत् performed
entries.55.12: निमिः तु and Nimi, राजा the king, नराधिपः lord of men, तान् those, विप्रान् brahmins, समानीय having assembled, स्वपुरस्य of his own city, समीपतः near by, हिमवत्पार्श्वे on the slope of Himavat, अयजत् sacrificed, राजा the king, पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि for five thousand years, दीक्षाम् the consecration, उपागमत् underwent
entries.55.13: इन्द्रयज्ञावसाने तु at the close of Indra's sacrifice, भगवान् the venerable, ऋषिः sage, अनिन्दितः the blameless, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, हौत्रम् the office of hotri, कर्तुम् to perform, राज्ञः of the king, सकाशम् to the presence, आगतः came
entries.55.14: अथ then, गौतमेन by Gautama, अभिपूरितम् already filled, तदन्तरम् that place, अपश्यत् he saw, ब्रह्मणः of Brahma, सुतः the son, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, महता by great, कोपेन wrath, आविष्टः was possessed
entries.55.15: सः he, राज्ञः of the king, दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी desiring an audience, मुहूर्तम् for a while, समुपाविशत् sat down, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, राजर्षिः the royal sage, निद्रया by sleep, भृशम् deeply, अपहृतः was carried off
entries.55.16: ततः then, महात्मनः of the great-souled, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishtha, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, अदर्शनेन by the failure to appear, मन्युः wrath, प्रादुरासीत् arose, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्रमे he began
entries.55.17: पार्थिव O king, यस्मात् since, त्वम् you, माम् me, अवज्ञाय having slighted, अन्यम् another, वृतवान् have chosen, तव your, देहः body, चेतनेन of consciousness, विनाभूतः bereft, भविष्यति shall become
entries.55.18: ततः then, प्रबुद्धः awakened, राजर्षिः the royal sage, उदाहृतम् pronounced, शापम् the curse, श्रुत्वा having heard, संरम्भात् out of agitation, क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with wrath, ब्रह्मयोनिम् to him sprung from Brahma, अथ then, उवाच said
entries.55.19: अजानतः of me who knew nothing, शयानस्य who lay asleep, क्रोधेन by wrath, कलुषीकृतः made turbid, मयि upon me, अपरम् another, यमदण्डम् इव like the rod of Yama, शापाग्निम् the fire of a curse, मुक्तवान् you have loosed
entries.55.20: ब्रह्मर्षे O brahmin sage, तस्मात् therefore, तव अपि yours too, सुरुचिरप्रख्यः of most beautiful appearance, देहः body, चेतनेन विना without consciousness, कृतः made, भविष्यति shall become, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.55.21: इति thus, रोषवशात् in the sway of anger, तदानीम् then, अन्योन्यम् each other, शपितौ having cursed, उभौ both, नृपद्विजेन्द्रौ the king and the lord of brahmins, तत्तुल्याधिगतप्रभाववन्तौ each possessed of power matching the other, सहसा एव all at once, विदेहौ bodiless, बभूवतुः became
